Chilling: 4 hours|difficulty=3 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] ==Ingredients== ===Crust=== * ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] * 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] * ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] * 2½ cups (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) bread [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] * 2 roasted [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|red bell peppers]], packed in oil ===Filling=== * 10 ounces [[Cookbook:Chocolate|milk chocolate]], cut into pieces * 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter * ½ teaspoon vanilla * ½ cup [[Cookbook:Vodka|pepper vodka]] * 1¼ cups white granulated sugar * 3 eggs * 1¼ cups (6 ounces) bread flour ===Topping=== * 1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] heavy [[Cookbook:Whipping Cream|whipping cream]] * 1 cup (4 ounces) [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|confectioners' sugar]] * ¼ cup pepper vodka * 12 ounces [[Cookbook:White Chocolate|white chocolate]], melted * ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]] ==Procedure== ===Crust=== # Place sugar, butter, egg and vanilla in a mixing bowl, and mix at low speed until combined. # Add flour and mix until incorporated; do not over mix. # Set the dough on a floured [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie pan]] and press flat. # Refrigerate until firm enough to roll out, 45 minutes to an hour. # After making filling, line an 11-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]] with the crust. # Line the bottom of the unbaked tart shell with a single thin layer of red bell peppers that have been wiped free of most of the oil. ===Filling=== # Melt chocolate and butter over low heat in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. # Stir in vanilla. # Take off the heat and add pepper vodka and let cool slightly. # While the chocolate mixture is cooling, whip the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. # Fold into cooled chocolate mixture. # [[Cookbook:Sift|Sift]] the flour into this mixture, making sure there are no lumps. # Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]]. # Pour chocolate mixture on top of red bell pepper layer, leaving ¾ inch at the top of pan. # [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about 20 minutes. The center should be soft, similar to a pumpkin pie when it is done. # Let cool before taking it out of the pan. # Refrigerate overnight before cutting. ===Topping=== # [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] cream and confectioners' sugar until peaks are thick, then slowly whip in vodka. # When vodka is completely mixed in, add melted white chocolate while whisking. # Refrigerate for 4 hours. # Top each piece with plenty of whipped cream, sprinkle lightly with nutmeg and enjoy.
